notes.title: KEEK 1.02 is live!
notes.content:
KEEK 1.02 UPDATE


 Added a blue pointer asset when using the force
 Optimized the visual effect of the force pointer when touching the save point
 Added a visual effect when the timer is disabled
 Added a feature to skip the logo screen by pressing the LMB, space, or jump button on the controller
 Optimized some controller's input mapping


Thanks so much for playing KEEK!

notes.title: Sep 1st Update
notes.content:
Now you can play in Full Screen mode!

After updating the game, you could simply select between windowed mode and full screen mode when launching the game.

Thank you very much for playing!

notes.title: KEEK 1.01 update
notes.content:
We've received many feedbacks since the release of KEEK. Now the 1.01 version is live, please check the list below for more detail. Thank you all so much for playing!


 Fixed a bug that occurs when pressing jump while the character is dashing.
 Adjusted the volume of some sound effects.
 Added some new sound effects.
 Removed all the soundtrack in the previous version.
 Added several new soundtracks. Now they will play randomly.
 Changed the method to continue the game.
 Now the default language will be automatically changed to the player's system language.
 Adjusted some art assets.
 Fixed errors that related to animation assets.
